meta.name: install
meta.description:
Install software any way the system allows. Recommends `x install` — one front door listing every
method and picking the best; plus `x eget`/`x env use`/`x pixi` channels and system package managers
with mirror switching. All x-cmd channels install in $HOME — no sudo, no pollution.
Use for "install", "apt", "brew", "eget", "pixi", "package manager", "mirror".

copy.tagline: 用统一命令安装任意软件，自动选最优方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不同系统上安装各种软件包
copy.tagline_en: Install any software with one unified command, auto-picking the best method
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to install various software packages across different systems

howto.what: 安装软件时，它会推荐 `x install` 命令，自动选择最佳安装方式。所有 x-cmd 通道（如 `x eget`、`x env use`、`x pixi`）都安装到 `$HOME` 目录，无需 sudo，不污染系统。系统包管理器（如 `x apt`、`x brew`）可能需 sudo。
howto.when: 当你说出“install”、“apt”、“brew”、“eget”、“pixi”、“package manager”、“mirror”等关键词，或要求安装软件时触发。
